title: Lantern Run
description: A free, cozy delivery game in a lantern-lit hillside village. Collect a parcel at the depot, follow a personal beacon to one of three houses, deliver it for session coins, and earn a visible cosmetic trail. Players have independent destinations, rewards, and village rounds.

files.source:
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local world = workspace:WaitForChild('World')
local spawnPart = world:WaitForChild('Depot Spawn') :: SpawnLocation
spawnPart.Neutral = true
local depot = world:WaitForChild('Depot Parcel Counter')
local shop = world:WaitForChild('Firefly Shop Counter')
local preview = world:WaitForChild('Firefly Preview Glow')
local houses = {
    ['West Cottage'] = world:WaitForChild('West Cottage Porch'),
    ['Hill House'] = world:WaitForChild('Hill House Porch'),
    ['Creek House'] = world:WaitForChild('Creek House Porch'),
}
local names = {'West Cottage', 'Hill House', 'Creek House'}
local PRICE = 10
local REWARD = 5
local event = Instance.new('RemoteEvent')
event.Name = 'LanternRunEvent'
event.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
local request = Instance.new('RemoteEvent')
request.Name = 'LanternRunRequest'
request.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
local states = {}

local function prompt(part, action, object)
    local p = Instance.new('ProximityPrompt')
    p.Name = 'LanternPrompt'
    p.ActionText = action
    p.ObjectText = object
    p.HoldDuration = 0.15
    p.MaxActivationDistance = 11
    p.RequiresLineOfSight = false
    p.Parent = part
    return p
end
local pickupPrompt = prompt(depot, 'Pick up parcel', 'Village Depot')
local shopPrompt = prompt(shop, 'Browse firefly trail', 'Session Coin Shop')
local housePrompts = {}
for _, name in ipairs(names) do
    housePrompts[name] = prompt(houses[name], 'Deliver parcel', name)
    local light = Instance.new('PointLight')
    light.Name = 'Porch Lantern'
    light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 105)
    light.Brightness = 1.2
    light.Range = 14
    light.Parent = houses[name]
end
local previewParticles = Instance.new('ParticleEmitter')
previewParticles.Name = 'Firefly Preview'
previewParticles.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 194, 90))
previewParticles.LightEmission = 1
previewParticles.Rate = 9
previewParticles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.4)
previewParticles.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.4)
previewParticles.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
previewParticles.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.24)
previewParticles.Parent = preview

local function near(player, part, distance)
    local character = player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
    return root ~= nil and humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0 and (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude <= distance
end
local function shuffled(exclude)
    local bag = {}
    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
        if name ~= exclude then table.insert(bag, name) end
    end
    for i = #bag, 2, -1 do
        local j = math.random(i)
        bag[i], bag[j] = bag[j], bag[i]
    end
    return bag
end
local function send(player, message, openShop)
    local s = states[player]
    if not s then return end
    event:FireClient(player, {
        kind = 'state', carrying = s.carrying, target = s.target,
        coins = s.coins, deliveries = s.deliveries, rounds = s.rounds,
        stamps = table.clone(s.stamps), owned = s.owned, equipped = s.equipped,
        price = PRICE, message = message, openShop = openShop == true,
    })
end
local function removeParcel(player)
    local character = player.Character
    if character then
        local old = character:FindFirstChild('Carried Parcel')
        if old then old:Destroy() end
    end
end
local function addParcel(player)
    removeParcel(player)
    local character = player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    if not root then return end
    local box = Instance.new('Part')
    box.Name = 'Carried Parcel'
    box.Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 0.8, 1)
    box.Color = Color3.fromRGB(242, 179, 92)
    box.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
    box.CanCollide = false
    box.CanTouch = false
    box.Massless = true
    box.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.4, -1.3)
    box.Parent = character
    local weld = Instance.new('WeldConstraint')
    weld.Part0 = root
    weld.Part1 = box
    weld.Parent = box
end
local function setTrail(player)
    local s = states[player]
    local character = player.Character
    if not s or not character then return end
    local root = character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    if not root then return end
    local old = root:FindFirstChild('Amber Firefly Trail')
    if old then old:Destroy() end
    for _, child in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
        if child.Name == 'Firefly Attachment' then child:Destroy() end
    end
    if not (s.owned and s.equipped) then return end
    local a = Instance.new('Attachment')
    a.Name = 'Firefly Attachment'
    a.Position = Vector3.new(-0.7, -1.4, 0.5)
    a.Parent = root
    local b = Instance.new('Attachment')
    b.Name = 'Firefly Attachment'
    b.Position = Vector3.new(0.7, -1.4, 0.5)
    b.Parent = root
    local trail = Instance.new('Trail')
    trail.Name = 'Amber Firefly Trail'
    trail.Attachment0 = a
    trail.Attachment1 = b
    trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 139), Color3.fromRGB(255, 142, 57))
    trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.15), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
    trail.Lifetime = 0.65
    trail.LightEmission = 1
    trail.MinLength = 0.07
    trail.Parent = root
    local sparks = Instance.new('ParticleEmitter')
    sparks.Name = 'Fireflies'
    sparks.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 101))
    sparks.LightEmission = 1
    sparks.Rate = 11
    sparks.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.8)
    sparks.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.1, 0.6)
    sparks.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.2)
    sparks.Parent = a
end
local function characterAdded(player, character)
    local s = states[player]
    if not s then return end
    s.carrying = false
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild('Humanoid', 10)
    if not humanoid or states[player] ~= s then return end
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        if states[player] ~= s then return end
        s.carrying = false
        removeParcel(player)
        send(player, 'Parcel returned to the depot. Your coins and stamps are safe!')
    end)
    task.defer(function()
        if states[player] ~= s then return end
        local root = character:WaitForChild('HumanoidRootPart', 10)
        if root and states[player] == s and player.Character == character then
            setTrail(player)
            send(player, 'Visit the lit parcel counter to start a delivery.')
        end
    end)
end
local function setup(player)
    if states[player] then return end
    player.RespawnLocation = spawnPart
    local stats = Instance.new('Folder')
    stats.Name = 'leaderstats'
    stats.Parent = player
    local coins = Instance.new('IntValue')
    coins.Name = 'Coins'
    coins.Parent = stats
    local deliveries = Instance.new('IntValue')
    deliveries.Name = 'Deliveries'
    deliveries.Parent = stats
    local rounds = Instance.new('IntValue')
    rounds.Name = 'Rounds'
    rounds.Parent = stats
    states[player] = {coins = 0, deliveries = 0, rounds = 0, carrying = false, target = nil, last = nil, first = true, bag = {}, stamps = {}, owned = false, equipped = false, lastRequest = 0, lastAction = 0, stats = {coins, deliveries, rounds}}
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character) characterAdded(player, character) end)
    if player.Character then task.spawn(characterAdded, player, player.Character) end
    send(player)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setup)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do setup(player) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    removeParcel(player)
    states[player] = nil
end)

pickupPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
    local s = states[player]
    if not s or not near(player, depot, 14) then return end
    if os.clock() - s.lastAction < 0.35 then return end
    s.lastAction = os.clock()
    if s.carrying then send(player, 'Already carrying a parcel. Follow your porch beacon!') return end
    if not s.target then
        if s.first then
            s.first = false
            s.target = 'West Cottage'
            s.bag = shuffled('West Cottage')
        else
            if #s.bag == 0 then
                s.stamps = {}
                s.bag = shuffled(s.last)
                if s.last then table.insert(s.bag, s.last) end
            end
            s.target = table.remove(s.bag, 1)
        end
    end
    s.carrying = true
    addParcel(player)
    send(player, 'Parcel collected! Follow the beacon to ' .. s.target .. '.')
end)
for _, name in ipairs(names) do
    housePrompts[name].Triggered:Connect(function(player)
        local s = states[player]
        if not s or not near(player, houses[name], 14) then return end
        if os.clock() - s.lastAction < 0.35 then return end
        s.lastAction = os.clock()
        if not s.carrying then send(player, 'Pick up a parcel at the depot first.') return end
        if s.target ~= name then send(player, 'This parcel belongs at ' .. tostring(s.target) .. '.') return end
        s.carrying = false
        s.target = nil
        s.last = name
        s.stamps[name] = true
        s.coins += REWARD
        s.deliveries += 1
        s.stats[1].Value = s.coins
        s.stats[2].Value = s.deliveries
        removeParcel(player)
        local lantern = houses[name]:FindFirstChild('Porch Lantern')
        if lantern then
            lantern.Brightness = 5
            task.delay(1.7, function()
                if lantern.Parent then lantern.Brightness = 1.2 end
            end)
        end
        local count = 0
        for _, house in ipairs(names) do if s.stamps[house] then count += 1 end end
        if count == 3 then
            s.rounds += 1
            s.stats[3].Value = s.rounds
            send(player, '+5 coins! Village round complete. Return to the depot for another route!')
        else
            send(player, '+5 coins! Return to the depot for your next parcel.')
        end
    end)
end
shopPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
    local s = states[player]
    if s and near(player, shop, 14) then send(player, 'Firefly trail: 10 session coins. Cosmetic only.', true) end
end)
request.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action)
    if type(action) ~= 'string' or #action > 12 then return end
    local s = states[player]
    if not s then return end
    if os.clock() - s.lastRequest < 0.22 then return end
    s.lastRequest = os.clock()
    if action == 'sync' then send(player) return end
    if not near(player, shop, 15) then send(player, 'Visit the teal shop stall beside the depot to browse.') return end
    if action == 'open' then
        send(player, 'Firefly trail: 10 session coins. Cosmetic only.', true)
    elseif action == 'buy' then
        if s.owned then send(player, 'Already owned this session. Use the equip button.', true) return end
        if s.coins < PRICE then send(player, 'You need ' .. tostring(PRICE - s.coins) .. ' more session coins.', true) return end
        s.coins -= PRICE
        s.stats[1].Value = s.coins
        s.owned = true
        s.equipped = true
        setTrail(player)
        send(player, 'Firefly trail unlocked and equipped for this session!', true)
    elseif action == 'toggle' then
        if not s.owned then send(player, 'Deliver twice to afford the trail.', true) return end
        s.equipped = not s.equipped
        setTrail(player)
        send(player, s.equipped and 'Firefly trail equipped!' or 'Firefly trail hidden.', true)
    end
end)

local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local world = workspace:WaitForChild('World')
local event = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild('LanternRunEvent')
local request = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild('LanternRunRequest')
local houses = {
    ['West Cottage'] = world:WaitForChild('West Cottage Porch'),
    ['Hill House'] = world:WaitForChild('Hill House Porch'),
    ['Creek House'] = world:WaitForChild('Creek House Porch'),
}
local depot = world:WaitForChild('Depot Parcel Counter')
local gui = Instance.new('ScreenGui')
gui.Name = 'Lantern Run HUD'
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')
local function make(className, properties, parent)
    local object = Instance.new(className)
    for key, value in pairs(properties) do object[key] = value end
    object.Parent = parent
    return object
end
local cream = Color3.fromRGB(252, 238, 204)
local dark = Color3.fromRGB(28, 67, 73)
local amber = Color3.fromRGB(255, 198, 111)
local panel = make('Frame', {Name = 'Objective Panel', Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 176), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12), BackgroundColor3 = dark, BackgroundTransparency = 0.08, BorderSizePixel = 0}, gui)
make('UICorner', {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)}, panel)
make('UIStroke', {Color = amber, Thickness = 2}, panel)
make('TextLabel', {Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 29), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 8), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = 'LANTERN RUN', TextColor3 = amber, TextSize = 22, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left}, panel)
local objective = make('TextLabel', {Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 39), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 39), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = 'Pick up a parcel at the depot', TextColor3 = cream, TextSize = 16, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left}, panel)
local distance = make('TextLabel', {Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 22), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 78), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = 'Walk to the glowing parcel counter.', TextColor3 = cream, TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left}, panel)
local stamps = make('TextLabel', {Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 25), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 102), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = 'Houses: ○ West  ○ Hill  ○ Creek', TextColor3 = amber, TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left}, panel)
local coins = make('TextLabel', {Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 26), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 128), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = '0 session coins   |   Round 1', TextColor3 = cream, TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left}, panel)
make('TextLabel', {Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 17), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 153), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = 'Walk • E or tap prompts • No timer', TextColor3 = amber, TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left}, panel)
local shopButton = make('TextButton', {Name = 'Shop Button', Size = UDim2.fromOffset(156, 44), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 198), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 111, 110), TextColor3 = cream, Text = '✦ Firefly shop', TextSize = 16, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold}, gui)
make('UICorner', {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)}, shopButton)
local toast = make('TextLabel', {Name = 'Feedback', Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 48), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -160, 0, 12), BackgroundColor3 = dark, BackgroundTransparency = 0.1, TextColor3 = cream, TextSize = 15, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextWrapped = true, Visible = false}, gui)
make('UICorner', {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)}, toast)
local shopPanel = make('Frame', {Name = 'Shop Panel', Size = UDim2.fromOffset(296, 178), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -148, 0.5, -89), BackgroundColor3 = dark, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false}, gui)
make('UICorner', {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)}, shopPanel)
make('UIStroke', {Color = amber, Thickness = 2}, shopPanel)
make('TextLabel', {Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 34), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 8), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = '✦ AMBER FIREFLIES', TextColor3 = amber, TextSize = 17, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left}, shopPanel)
local close = make('TextButton', {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 34), Position = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, 6), Text = '×', TextSize = 25, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextColor3 = cream, BackgroundTransparency = 1}, shopPanel)
make('TextLabel', {Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 72), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 46), Text = 'A visible trail for your village walks.\n10 session coins • cosmetic only\nOwnership resets when you leave.', TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, TextColor3 = cream, TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, BackgroundTransparency = 1}, shopPanel)
local buy = make('TextButton', {Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 43), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 125), Text = 'Buy for 10 session coins', TextColor3 = dark, TextSize = 15, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, BackgroundColor3 = amber}, shopPanel)
make('UICorner', {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)}, buy)
local marker = make('BillboardGui', {Name = 'Personal Porch Beacon', Size = UDim2.fromOffset(175, 64), StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 7, 0), AlwaysOnTop = true, MaxDistance = 180, Enabled = false}, gui)
local markerText = make('TextLabel', {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Text = '✦ DESTINATION', TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 74, 76), BackgroundColor3 = amber, BackgroundTransparency = 0.06, TextSize = 16, TextWrapped = true, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold}, marker)
make('UICorner', {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)}, markerText)
local data = nil
local toastSerial = 0
local function feedback(text)
    if type(text) ~= 'string' or text == '' then return end
    toastSerial += 1
    local serial = toastSerial
    toast.Text = text
    toast.Visible = true
    task.delay(3.5, function()
        if serial == toastSerial then toast.Visible = false end
    end)
end
local function refresh()
    if not data then return end
    local targetPart
    if data.carrying and type(data.target) == 'string' and houses[data.target] then
        targetPart = houses[data.target]
        objective.Text = 'Deliver to ' .. data.target
        marker.Adornee = targetPart
        markerText.Text = '✦ ' .. string.upper(data.target) .. '\nDELIVER HERE'
        marker.Enabled = true
    else
        targetPart = depot
        objective.Text = data.target and ('Pick up again: ' .. data.target) or 'Pick up a parcel at the depot'
        marker.Enabled = false
    end
    local reached = data.stamps or {}
    stamps.Text = 'Houses: ' .. (reached['West Cottage'] and '●' or '○') .. ' West  ' .. (reached['Hill House'] and '●' or '○') .. ' Hill  ' .. (reached['Creek House'] and '●' or '○') .. ' Creek'
    coins.Text = tostring(data.coins or 0) .. ' session coins   |   Round ' .. tostring((data.rounds or 0) + 1)
    if data.owned then
        buy.Text = data.equipped and 'Hide equipped trail' or 'Equip owned trail'
    else
        buy.Text = 'Buy for ' .. tostring(data.price or 10) .. ' session coins'
    end
    local character = player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    if root and targetPart then
        local studs = math.floor((root.Position - targetPart.Position).Magnitude + 0.5)
        distance.Text = tostring(studs) .. ' studs away • ' .. (data.carrying and 'E or tap porch prompt' or 'E or tap depot prompt')
    end
end
shopButton.Activated:Connect(function() request:FireServer('open') end)
close.Activated:Connect(function() shopPanel.Visible = false end)
buy.Activated:Connect(function()
    if data then request:FireServer(data.owned and 'toggle' or 'buy') end
end)
event.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)
    if type(packet) ~= 'table' or packet.kind ~= 'state' then return end
    data = packet
    if packet.openShop then shopPanel.Visible = true end
    refresh()
    feedback(packet.message)
end)
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.defer(refresh) end)
request:FireServer('sync')
task.spawn(function()
    while gui.Parent do
        refresh()
        task.wait(0.35)
    end
end)

instructions: Walk from the supported depot spawn to the glowing parcel counter. Press E or tap its ProximityPrompt to collect a parcel. Follow your personal porch beacon and distance guide, then press E or tap the assigned porch prompt to deliver. Each delivery earns 5 session coins. Return to the depot and repeat; visit all three houses to complete a village round. At the teal stall beside the depot, use its prompt or the Firefly shop button to buy a cosmetic trail for 10 session coins. Shop buttons support mouse and touch. There is no timer or required jump.
testPlan: In Studio, verify the 77 named scene parts appear, Depot Spawn is supported by Depot Plaza, and both scripts start without Output errors.

Walk the entire north route with a default avatar. Check that North Rise Two and North Rise Three remain exposed, that their surfaces meet North Hill Landing without a terrain lip or required jump, and that Hill House’s porch prompt is reachable.
Pick up the first parcel, follow the West Cottage beacon, deliver at its porch, and verify the parcel disappears, porch brightens, one stamp fills, and exactly 5 coins are awarded.
Return for two more parcels, deliver to Hill House and Creek House in their assigned order, verify the round-completion message, and collect another parcel to begin the next round.
Earn 10 coins, buy the trail at the shop, and check its appearance from a second player's view. Hide and re-equip it; verify no second deduction.
Try the wrong porch, repeat a completed porch prompt, and send repeated shop requests. Verify these grant no extra delivery, coins, or purchase.
Reset while carrying. Verify respawn at Depot Spawn, retained coins and stamps, removal of the parcel, and pickup for the pending destination.

Test two players with independent destinations and have one leave. Check the remaining player's progress, every walking route, bridge rails, porch prompt reach, camera sightlines, keyboard controls, and emulated touch layouts.
notes: Repair: North Upper Terrace now starts at z=35, beyond the exposed ramps, rather than covering North Rise Two and North Rise Three. Hill Birch was moved onto the resized terrace. Default-avatar verification in Studio is still required; no playtest result is claimed.
The intended audience is players who enjoy cozy exploration, light role-play, and short solo or side-by-side tasks. The earnable trail changes appearance, not movement or rewards.
Coins, stamps, rounds, and trail ownership are session-only. There are no DataStores, Robux purchases, product IDs, or persistent-progression claims.

Optional future offer, not enabled here: a permanent, cosmetic-only Moonlight Ribbon game pass. Before enabling it, the owner would need to configure and publish the pass, display its runtime price, verify ownership on the server, and specify persistence for any non-pass cosmetics. The free amber trail and complete delivery loop would remain available.

Launch measurement plan, not implemented telemetry: after publication, measure valid pickup within 30 seconds divided by new spawns; first delivery within 5 minutes divided by new spawns; second delivery within 10 minutes of the first divided by first-delivery players; trail purchase within 15 minutes of reaching 10 coins divided by players reaching 10 coins; and next-calendar-day return divided by first-visit players. Segment by device and investigate route or prompt clarity when completion is low.
An honest launch clip could show parcel pickup, the bridge route, porch delivery, and the free trail. Studio playtesting and published-game analytics setup remain follow-up work.

AI static review: Static review: the supported depot spawn, three-house delivery loop, server-owned rewards, session-coin shop, respawn handling, and replay path are implemented coherently. The previously identified north-route terrace overlap has been corrected. Traversal and touch layouts still need Studio verification; this was not playtested. This is not a Studio playtest.

businessPlan.audience: Players who like cozy Roblox villages, light role-play, and short tasks they can complete alone or alongside friends.
businessPlan.hook: A parcel visibly changes hands, then a personal porch beacon draws the player through an authored lantern village.
businessPlan.retentionLoop: Finish a three-house round, earn the free session trail, and replay the routes with friends or aim for a smoother village circuit. This prototype makes no persistent-return promise.

offers.name: Moonlight Ribbon trail — future proposal only
offers.purchaseType: Permanent cosmetic game pass, not enabled in this offline build
offers.playerValue: An optional teal ribbon appearance for deliveries; no speed, coins, or route advantage.
offers.freeAlternative: Earn and equip the amber firefly trail with session coins; the full delivery game remains free.
offers.setupRequired: Before any live prompt, the owner must configure and publish the pass, show its actual runtime price, and have the server verify pass ownership before granting the effect. Game passes use server ownership verification, not developer-product ProcessReceipt; if a future offer becomes a developer product, persist receipt identity and its grant idempotently through server ProcessReceipt before returning PurchaseGranted. Configure persistence separately for any promised saved non-pass cosmetics. No product IDs, DataStores, or purchase calls are in this offline build.

metrics.name: First pickup
metrics.definition: Unique new players with a valid pickup within 30 seconds of spawn ÷ unique new players who spawned, per launch-day cohort; plan server spawn and pickup events after publishing.
metrics.decision: If low, revise counter visibility and the first HUD cue.

metrics.name: First delivery
metrics.definition: Unique new players completing one delivery within 5 minutes of spawn ÷ unique new players who spawned, per launch-day cohort; plan server delivery events.
metrics.decision: If low after pickup, inspect waypoint clarity, route readability, and porch prompt reach.

metrics.name: Voluntary replay
metrics.definition: Unique players completing a second delivery within 10 minutes of their first ÷ unique players completing a first delivery, per daily cohort; plan server delivery-order events.
metrics.decision: If low, improve the return-to-depot cue or route variety before adding content.

metrics.name: Free shop use
metrics.definition: Unique players buying the firefly trail within 15 minutes of first reaching 10 session coins ÷ unique players who reached 10 coins, per daily cohort; plan server balance-threshold and shop-grant events.
metrics.decision: If low, test shop visibility and the trail preview, not a paid shortcut.

metrics.name: Next-day return
metrics.definition: Unique players in a first-visit calendar-day cohort who open the published game again the following calendar day ÷ unique first-visit players in that cohort; plan to read published Roblox cohort analytics, segmented by device.
metrics.decision: Use alongside completion data to decide whether more route variety merits development; do not infer persistence or revenue from it.

launchPlan: Build and review the free two-script slice first; keep all real-money UI and purchase handling disabled.
Capture an honest thumbnail and short clip showing pickup, the bridge route, porch delivery, and the earnable trail—not unbuilt features.
After publication, configure the proposed server events and inspect onboarding by device; Studio runs alone do not establish live analytics delivery.

Playtest route and prompt issues, adjust the first loop, then evaluate the cosmetic pass separately only if the owner elects to configure the required production systems. Revenue is a hypothesis, not a launch promise.
